channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.49.0 (131)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.49.0

Build 131

  • Brush edits update more reliably while drawing
  • Unchanged slider gestures preserve undo and redo history
  • Numeric slider entry opens immediately
  • Phone tool tabs open correctly; Collage keeps controls and caption focus when the keyboard opens
  • Clearer preview status and reachable Export controls
